newsitem.title: FINLAND: METSALIITTO UPS STAKE IN S.FORESTIA.
newsitem.headline: METSALIITTO UPS STAKE IN S.FORESTIA.

text.p: Finnish investment company Oy Sijoitus Forestia Ab said in a statement on Wednesday that cooperative Metsaliitto had increased its ownership in it to above 33.3 percent.

Metsaliitto, owner of forestry group Metsa-Serla , said in a seperate statement its share of votes in Sijoitus Forestia had increased to 49.8 percent through a purchase of 90,000 K shares from OKOBANK and Tapiola.
Metsaliitto's share of the company's capital is now 15.8 percent, it said.
As a result of the deal OKOBANK's and Tapiola's share of votes has decreased below 10 percent, Forestia said.
Metsaliitto said the purchase price was based on the net asset value per share.
